title: FlakyRegistry — registered (pre-existing) flaky tests and their quarantines (Standard §7.14; FE §8.8)
description: Generated from intermittent failures on main (FE §8.8, suggested window 30 days). A quarantine is decided by the owner of the test or check only (Standard §7.14 item 4): decidedBy must equal owner, enforced by lib/flaky.mjs because JSON Schema cannot compare two fields.

window.description: History window on main the registry is generated from

owner.description: Owner of the test or check (a person or team, never an agent)

fixBy.description: Deadline to fix (Standard §7.14 item 5); after it the quarantine no longer counts

mainFailures.description: Intermittent failures on main inside the window (Standard §7.14 item 1)

replacementVerifier.description: Required when the test protects a critical acceptance criterion (Standard §7.14 item 6)
